Cancelled purchase orders no longer count in the per-rep purchase-order report. The `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` suite passes (4 tests, 0 failures).

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, around line 6514): added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the other per-rep and purchase-order reports use. I also updated the Javadoc to say cancelled purchase orders are not counted.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added a `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test that reproduces your example (Anna 2, Bob 1 with two cancelled South orders). I also gave the `purchaseOrder` test helper an overload that takes a status.

Nothing was committed. The only other caller is the demo scenario in `DemoScenario.java`, which just prints the report.
